covered: Preview and final projection return historical text fallback; valid, malformed, unfenced, nested-list and partial source never creates lesson controls or leaks transport source.
New lesson candidates are rejected with bounded plain-text correction; ordinary code and quoted examples remain text.
Production context no longer advertises the catalog or historical revisions; native worker corrects a valid lesson to one durable plain-text reply without UI revision rows.
GET state, PUT state and POST action return 410 for an authorized caller; foreign tenant/project still return 403 or 404 through existing authorization.
Historical IM content, revision rows and saved personal state remain unchanged after blocked operations.
Old admitted receipts fail generic acceptance and webhook admission; invalid webhook signature remains 401, valid signature reaches the 410 shutdown boundary.
Committed receive rejects old UI actions with 410 and rejects a mismatched authenticated principal before shutdown; blocked actions create no send, state or Agent wake effects.
Accepted historical delivery returns the stored receipt without another send; unknown ACK with a durable message reconciles the original payload/digest and commits its pending revision.
Unknown dispatch with no authoritative IM message remains pending and is never resent; new deliveries contain text and reserve no UI revision.
Existing native admission/cancellation/revision/ACK replay and mixed attachment message regressions remain successful.

reproduction.prerequisites: Repository-locked dependencies, existing local PostgreSQL/Redis services and a freshly migrated dedicated test database. Never use a product/shared database.
reproduction.environment: Use the repository integration test environment with INTEGRATION_DATABASE_URL naming the dedicated database above, REDIS_URL database 8, NODE_ENV=test, embeddings and Open Notebook disabled, loopback model endpoint and synthetic local placeholders. Set AGENT_OS_PYTHON to an available Python 3 executable for worker doctor checks.

limitations: Nine former enabled-mode persistence/action cases are explicitly skipped because controls are hard-disabled; these skips do not establish enabled-mode acceptance.
Offline source parsing and numerical kernels remain tested for historical data and experiments. Production re-enablement still requires the complete real-model and browser gate.
No complete repository suite, real model, production browser, physical-device accessibility or production deployment was run in this server task.
Raw terminal logs remain local; this report and the scripted-runtime artifact contain no prompts or real credentials.
